title: Gates
subtitle: Doors into other worlds that form among the Valeoran Ruins
summary: A Gate is an opening among the Valeoran Ruins into another world. What they are is unknown; each is classified by the Gate Evaluation Committee, and each holds, or is believed to hold, a Core.
content:
A **Gate** is a portal into another world that forms among the [[valeoran-ruins|Valeoran Ruins]]: some years after the Ruins were found, researchers saw parts of them begin to move and gather together, and where they met, a way through opened. Beyond one there might be a frozen plain, an enclosed jungle, a red forest or an amber wetland. Crews cross the **threshold**, explore, and bring things back. Before the Gates, the world had no magic at all; nearly everything magical in [[endros|Endros]] came through one.

What the Gates are, who or what made them, and why they form is unknown. Every Gate investigated so far holds, or is believed to hold, a [[cores|Core]], and taking a Core out through its Gate makes the Gate collapse.

Each Gate has a **designation** (G-01, G-02…) and a **classification** set by the [[gate-evaluation-committee|Gate Evaluation Committee]]: *emerging*, *active*, *restricted*, *quarantined*, *dormant*, *collapsed*, *sealed* or *lost*. The classification decides who may cross, with what, and what may come back. Every notice of classification ends with the same line:

> *A classification describes what is known at the date of issue. It is not a statement of safety.*

Expeditioners read it as a joke the first time and as advice afterwards. Each known Gate has its own record on the [Gates](gates.html) page.
